Thanks for the context. I reviewed the PO and the redlined Order Form (see attached). High-level guidance:

- Net terms: Finance has historically capped new-customer commercial net terms at net45 without CFO sign-off. I recommend we counter with net45 and offer a net60 exception only upon explicit Finance approval and an updated risk acceptance from Sales.

- PO acceptance: We can accept a customer PO but will require an appendix referencing the Order Form SOW and price schedule. The PO should not be treated as a substitute for the signed Order Form.

Attached: Aurelia_OrderForm_v3_legal_redlined.pdf — contains suggested edits to the payment, tax, and invoicing sections.

1) Ask Aurelia to confirm invoicing entity and provide VAT registration (attachment or portal link).

3) If Aurelia insists on net60, route to Karthik for expedited Finance review and CFO approval path.
